debts.description: Extract theorem-level locators and final publication status for every 2025-2026 current-frontier record before any theorem-strengthening or novelty claim.
No unrestricted lower-bound interface currently composes to PNP-T-130; every restricted-model result requires a proved transfer.
No algorithm interface supplies a uniform deterministic worst-case polynomial-time SAT decider under WP00 bit-cost accounting.
Hardness magnification, hardness-versus-randomness, and SAT-to-lower-bound records are conditional transfers whose premises remain independent theorem obligations.
MATHCERT formalization is limited to finite encodings, reduction composition, implication direction, fixture replay, and ledger consistency; no terminal lower bound is formalized.
Repository review, authoritative integration, and merge are required before WP01 or WP02 may be recorded as promoted.
